**Finding submitted — deviation (§ 14.10 Assignment).**

- **Issue:** The restriction binds only Bluefly; IBM is unconstrained and could assign the Agreement to anyone, including a competitor of ours. Customer's carve-out also omits affiliates and sales of substantially all assets.
- **Mitigating:** No IBM termination or re-pricing right on our change of control anywhere in the document, so this is not walk-away.
- **Redline (validated, preferred position):** mutual consent requirement (not unreasonably withheld), bar on IBM assigning to our competitor, and an affiliate/merger/asset-sale carve-out for our assignments.
